lines.text: I've already sighed about tomorrow twice. Pacing myself.
I asked for a different tomorrow. This was the only one in stock.
Current you, future you. Neither one's my best work.
I've got two complaints about tomorrow. The weather's the second one.
I asked for the snow to land somewhere more scenic. Apparently this is it.
I'll draw the snow cleaner than it'll stay. Professional courtesy.
lines.was: I'll draw the snow cleaner than it stays. Professional courtesy.

lines.text: Fewer layers to draw. I won't pretend I'm not relieved.
lines.was: Fewer layers to draw tomorrow. I won't pretend I'm not relieved.

lines.text: Saturday and colder. Somebody had plans.
